Hi Alex + Priya,

Thanks for the time today - great conversation. Summarizing the call and suggested next steps so we have alignment:

- Key business context: FintechX wants to add a conversational underwriting assistant and a personalized recommendations API (two primary features) with low latency for customer UX.
- Expected token profile: short prompts (~50 tokens) with longer generated responses (~200 tokens) per request (average ~250 tokens/interaction). Peak concurrency estimates: ~300 rps during batch hours.
- Initial target volumes (you mentioned on the call): 30M-50M tokens/month, with 60-80M tokens/month in Q3 if rollout expands.

Pricing & unit-econ asks: please confirm these items so we can run a model-specific unit-econ:
1) Target budget range (monthly) for inference: you mentioned roughly $50k- $120k/month - confirm?
2) Which KPIs drive acceptance: target $/1M tokens, CAC payback window, and margin targets (% gross margin on features).

Attached: initial unit economics model (editable) and a short assumptions tab. I put a first-pass target of $/1M tokens: $350- $450 depending on quantization and batching. That maps to feature-level cost (example below):

- Conversational assistant: ~0.9-1.5M tokens/day => $315-675/day at $350/1M => per-customer/month math in the attached model.

Next steps:
- You: confirm monthly budget range + any existing contracts/benchmarks we should match
- We: share a tuned unit-econ model and schedule a technical deep-dive w/ Marcus (solutions) + Sean (SRE)
- Proposed deep-dive: 30-45 minute session next week - Tue/Wed AM PT?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa - good summary. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- Volume: current conservative estimate is 30M tokens/month (pilot, 5k MAU), but if adoption is good we expect 60-80M tokens/month in Q3 across both features. Peak day could get close to 4-6M tokens/day.
- Budget: band we can allocate initially is $50k- $120k/month; the exact number depends on the unit-econ you can hit for $/1M tokens and the per-feature ROI.
- KPIs: the product team is focused on $/1M tokens and feature-level margin. PMs are targeting a >60% gross margin on the feature after inference costs. CAC payback target is 3-6 months for feature-led acquisition.

Can you confirm your $/1M token target again and how that maps to per-feature cost? Also include assumptions for quantization (8-bit vs 4-bit) and batching - we care about tail latency too.

I can do a deep-dive slot Wed 9:30am PT or Thu 11:00am PT. Please send calendar invite.

Best,
Alex

Alex - thanks, that helps. Attaching a first-pass model with clearer per-feature outputs (FintechX_unit_econ_model_v1.xlsx). High-level notes below (we'll run numbers more precisely in the shared sheet during the deep-dive):

Assumptions (first-pass):
- Token mix: avg 250 tokens/interaction (50 prompt + 200 response)
- Monthly volume scenarios: Pilot=30M, Growth=60M, Scale=80M
- Model choices: 1) medium Llama-family (base) optimized with 8-bit quantization - baseline cost estimate; 2) 4-bit + tuned kernels for aggressive cost savings (higher ops risk)
- Batching & caching: continuous batching + prefix caching expected to reduce effective tokens by ~10-20% for recommendation workflows

Cost guidance (ballpark):
- Baseline (8-bit, tuned runtime): $350/1M tokens
- Aggressive (4-bit + optimized kernels + batching): $250- $300/1M tokens

Feature-level mapping (example):
- Conversational assistant (pilot): ~1.0M tokens/day => ~30M/month => $10.5k/month at $350/1M
- Recommendations API: depends on call frequency; example 0.5M tokens/day => 15M/month => $5.25k/month at $350/1M
\CAC & payback: using your numbers, if ARPU/per-customer uplift covers inference and other infra, we estimate CAC payback 3-6 months under the Growth scenario; exact depends on feature monetization and conversion lift (we included a simple CAC sheet in the workbook).

I'll coordinate with Marcus to prepare a short slide that shows margin sensitivity to $/1M tokens and quantization level.

Quick engineering / ops notes from my side - adding here so Alex/Priya have visibility before the call: 

- Inference cost levers: model size, quantization, batching window, KV cache hit rate, and routing policies. We should model both average and 95th percentile tail costs since your latency SLAs will drive sizing.
- Realistic savings: 8-bit -> 4-bit + optimized kernels can reduce token $ by ~20-30% in practice; batching (with latency SLOs tuned) can add another 10-25% savings depending on request distribution.
- Target $/1M tokens: based on similar customers, practical target range is $250- $450/1M depending on aggressiveness and acceptable SLOs. For FintechX given 60-80M volume upside, we should aim for $300- $350/1M as a balance of cost and reliability.
- Margin targets: to get to your >60% gross margin on the feature, the team will need to ensure feature revenue per active user is > 2x inference cost allocated per active user (model in the sheet).
- CAC payback: assume 3-6 months; if your LTV/CAC model requires sub-3 month payback we'll need to push cost lower (toward $250/1M) or find incremental monetization on the feature.

Recommendation for the deep-dive: 1) run the workbook with your real ARPU/usage numbers ahead of the call; 2) have your PM share target gross margin and payback timeframe so we can show two scenarios (conservative vs aggressive).

I'll join Wed 09:30am PT and bring a short ops slide deck.

- Marcus
